notes.title: V 1.3.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Samurai Riot | Patch 1.3.2

Update: 1280 x 720 ratio is now supported.

Fixed: When remapped, Player 1 controls don't affects player 2 in the menu anymore.
Fixed: The key remapping save is now fully operational.

notes.title: V 1.3.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Samurai Riot | Patch 1.3.1

 Fixed: Save file cannot be corrupted anymore because of the 1.3.0 patch. 
 Fixed: The menu will no longer freeze on the "press start" menu. 
 Fixed: Azu will get his second tail even if you play Tsurumaru.
 Fixed: Characters now say the correct phrases after a PvP fight.

notes.title: V 1.3.0 – Major update
notes.notes:
Samurai Riot | Version 1.3.0
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30058497/42f688c08138401f49b66308b0298e7a0b3ade55.png

 Update: A new loading screen has been added
 Update: The game has been optimised to require fewer resources, especially in terms of RAM.
 Update: The loading times are now shorter.
 Update: Sukane's air strikes have been optimized.

 Bug fix: Destructible objects no longer cause any lag.
 Bug fix: The camera movements in the cut-scenes no longer cause any lag.
 Bug fix: A wave of enemies has been removed in the Sky City chapters.

notes.title: V 1.2.0 - Major Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30058497/cdf2f44805c3b78a48ea9a1f10f8331b30e3350b.png

• Major addition: 24 Steam achievements!
• Major addition: There is now a Co-op save slot, different from the solo save.

• Upgrade: The video introductions have been optimized
• Upgrade: A couple of environments have been edited in Sky City
• Upgade: The life of the boss “Oni” has been lowered
• Upgrade: The strength of the boss “Yojimbo” has been lowered
• Upgrade: In Easy mode, you’ll be starting the game with 5 lives

• Fixed: In Sky City, teleportation glich concerning enemies is now fixed.
• Fixed: Sukane is no longer blocked by the Machina in Kappa Caves.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Samurai Riot | Version 1.0.2

 Added: The default fury level in a PvP fight is now 1 gauge.
 Added: The dialogues can be skipped by pressing Space.
 Added: Sukane’s shuriken (Azu) is more powerfull.
 Added: The “Rhynoceros” combat school is more effective.
 Added: Sukane’s air attacks are more powerfull.

 Fixed the dialogues occurrence issue.
 Fixed: USB devices are no longer considered as unknown controllers after a game over.
 Fixed: The fury is now correctly indicated in Player 2 command list.
 Fixed: Azu can now attack as a shuriken if released during a jump or a run.
 Fixed: Azu won’t disapear after a grab on a unblockable ennemy if Tsurumaru is already grabbing it.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Samurai Riot | Version 1.0.1

  Added Story choices with keyboard by pressing the 1 and 2 keys without the num pad.
 Fixed the ennemy red HIT frame that were going over players when performing a grab attack.
 Resolved issue where you were able to kill a player with grenades or poison after the end of a PvP fight. 
 Fixed the co-op gauge reset after a screen change in the same level. 
 Added compatibility with more game controllers.
 Fixed controllers issues after a disconnection and reconnection.
 Resolved issue where some USB devices were considered as unknown controllers.
 Fixed controller issue by forcing controller to player 1 when only one game controller is connected.
 Added testers in the game credits.
 Fixed typos.
